description: In response to the EU's ASML Sovereignty Shield proposal and the escalating transatlantic tensions, the United States initiates a quiet diplomatic freeze on high-level technology coordination with EU institutions. Working groups on AI standards and export enforcement are suspended indefinitely, and intelligence sharing on dual-use technology flows slows. The move is framed as 'reviewing alignment', but signals that Washington will treat the ESECA proposal as a strategic challenge unless withdrawn or substantially modified.
